datum: V. Thou shalt make them princes over all the earth.
R. They shall be mindful of Thy Name, O Lord.
Peter the Apostle, * and Paul the Teacher of the Gentiles, have taught us Thy law, O Lord.

O God, Whose Right Hand caught the Blessed Peter when he walked upon the water, and began to sink, and thrice delivered his fellow-Apostle Paul from the deep of the sea, when he suffered shipwreck; + graciously hear us, and grant, * for the sake of them both, that we also may attain unto everlasting glory.
V. Their sound is gone out through all the earth.
R. And their words to the ends of the earth.
These are glorious princes * over all the earth, they loved one another in their lives, and in their death they were not divided.
